title: Fix broken code tab selector (CodeTabs) + add regression test
author: Wei Chen
description:
Context: INT-3321 reported that the language code tabs on the Streaming guide stopped switching content (clicking "Python"/"TypeScript"/"Go" updated the tab UI but the code blocks did not change). This started after the recent CodeTabs refactor that moved tab state into a shared hook and introduced per-page persisted language preference.

Root cause: the tab selector was reading the selected tab value from localStorage (e.g. "typescript") while the rendered tab list used display labels (e.g. "TypeScript") and a different `data-tab` attribute. After hydration, the hook would treat the stored value as invalid, fall back to default, and then subsequent clicks only updated the tab header state (not the underlying code block visibility), because the querySelector used the wrong attribute.

Fix: normalize to a single canonical key (`python` | `typescript` | `go`) across: (1) the tab button `value`, (2) code block `data-language`, and (3) persisted localStorage key. Also ensure the DOM update runs after hydration and targets only the nearest CodeTabs container so multiple tab groups on a page don’t interfere.

What changed:
- CodeTabs now uses `value` keys and renders `data-language` consistently.
- `usePreferredLanguage()` sanitizes localStorage values (unknown/legacy values -> default).
- CodeBlock wrapper applies an explicit `data-language` on the outer container (not the inner pre), which fixes selector brittleness across MDX transformations.
- Added a Playwright regression test that loads the Streaming guide and asserts tab switching actually changes the visible code content.

Before/after screenshots:
- Before (broken): docs/_screenshots/INT-3321-before.png
- After (fixed): docs/_screenshots/INT-3321-after.png

Test plan:
- Local: `pnpm install && pnpm dev` then open /guides/streaming and click language tabs; verify code content switches and the copy button copies the visible tab content.
- Persistence: select Go tab, refresh page, confirm Go remains selected.
- Multiple groups: verify tab switching in one group does not change other groups on the page.
- E2E: `pnpm test:e2e tests/code-tabs.spec.ts`.

Notes:
- This PR is intentionally scoped to the selector/state mismatch + regression coverage. It does not change the docs content or example text beyond ensuring tab keys match the conventions we use in the updated streaming/tool calling guides.
commits: fix(codetabs): normalize tab keys + scope DOM updates to nearest container
fix(codeblock): apply stable data-language on wrapper for tab filtering
test(e2e): add playwright regression for language tab switching
